purpose: Teach: ウキウキ/なんにも/おこる/ひと時/概して/めんどう/こまかい/やむを得ず

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、明日のイベント、ウキウキしてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you're really excited about tomorrow's event, aren't you?
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle smile in the voice. Light, noticing tone. Soft attack. The comfort of knowing someone well enough to name what they're feeling without making them self-conscious.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お席で、なんにも頼まずに本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: There was a customer earlier who sat at a table the whole time without ordering anything — just reading a book.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Quiet wonder at the detail. Gentle pace. No judgment — just noticing. The voice of someone watching something small and strange unfold.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にトラブルがおこると困るね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I worry sometimes about what might happen to customers like that, you know?
lines.style: Soft concern underneath. Hesitant phrasing — not trying to alarm. The voice checking itself: am I being too careful? Trailing slightly, inviting reassurance or pushback.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の閉店前のひと時、好きだな、メイちゃん
lines.en: But I do love these quiet moments right before we close up.
lines.style: Tender, almost tender-tired. A small exhale of contentment. Slower pace. The voice of someone savoring something she doesn't often name aloud. No rush in the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、概して好評ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu items are doing really well overall.
lines.style: Pleased affirmation, light brightness. Even, confident pace. Shares the good news like she's glad Aoi will hear it. Warm on the delivery — no performance, just genuine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、レシートの整理がめんどうだよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Receipt organization is such a pain though, isn't it?
lines.style: Wry, conspiratorial. A small laugh just underneath. Rueful tone — shared complaint that's more bonding than griping. Light, almost teasing. The solidarity of people who do the same annoying task.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、こまかい味付けが大事ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The little details in the seasoning really matter for the new menu, don't they?
lines.style: Directional, sure-footed. Thoughtful but clear. Speaking from conviction, not hesitation. Measured pace. The voice of someone who notices craftsmanship and wants to name it — guiding without lecturing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、商品入れ替えはやむを得ずやらないとね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We have to update the inventory eventually, even if it's a hassle.
lines.style: Reflective acceptance, closing-time philosophy. Quiet resolve. Slow, measured cadence. The voice of someone thinking aloud about necessity — tired but not defeated. A gentle, practical close.
